newsitem.title: USA: Metro One sees Q4 revs about $4.67 mln.
newsitem.headline: Metro One sees Q4 revs about $4.67 mln.

text.p: Metro One Telecommunications Inc said Monday it expects to report revenue of $4.67 million for the 1996 fourth quarter, up 19 pct from a year ago.
Full year 1996 revenue is expected to be roughly $17.8 million, up 36 percent from 1995, Metro One said.

In a statement, the company said fourth quarter and full year results will include net charges of about $100,000, primarily for the write-off of assets after an upgrade of computer and communications equipment. The company plans to announce 1996 financial results at the end of February.
